Find members by name

Source: R/query-speeches.R
find_member.Rd

Looks members up by name and returns their PHIDs, the member ids every other function takes.

Usage

find_member(name, chamber = NULL, active_during = NULL)

Arguments

name

A single string: one or more name pieces separated by spaces.

chamber

"house" and/or "senate", in any case.

active_during

A year, a Date, a "YYYY-MM-DD" string, or in_range(): keep people whose service overlaps it. A service with no end date counts as ongoing.

Value

A tibble with one row per matching member, ordered by DisplayName, with columns PHID, DisplayName, Gender, DateOfBirth, State, chambers (the chambers the person ever served in, such as "house, senate"), first_service (the earliest service start) and last_service (the latest service end, NA while any service is ongoing or has no end date). The three service columns describe all of the person's service, whatever the filters. Zero rows if nobody matches; that is not an error.

Details

name is split on whitespace, and every piece must occur somewhere in members.DisplayName, ignoring case and in any order. DisplayName is stored as, for example, "HOWARD, the Hon. John Winston, AC", so "john howard", "Howard John" and "howard" all find it. Characters such as % and _ are matched literally.

chamber and active_during keep only people with a period of parliamentary service (parl_service) in that chamber and overlapping that period. Service as a Member is the House and as a Senator the Senate. With neither filter, members without any recorded service are kept too.

See also

get_speeches(), get_members()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
find_member("john howard")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   PHID  DisplayName Gender DateOfBirth State chambers first_service last_service
#>   <chr> <chr>       <chr>  <date>      <chr> <chr>    <date>        <date>      
#> 1 ZD4   HOWARD, th… Male   1939-07-26  New … house    1974-05-18    2007-11-24  
find_member("peter", chamber = "house", active_during = 2012)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   PHID  DisplayName Gender DateOfBirth State chambers first_service last_service
#>   <chr> <chr>       <chr>  <date>      <chr> <chr>    <date>        <date>      
#> 1 00AKI DUTTON, th… Male   1970-11-18  Quee… house    2001-11-10    2025-05-03  
db_disconnect()
